svg.title: MedMe token system — chain of custody in three phases
svg.desc: Three-phase bilateral token system showing how each token resolves a different trust problem for patient, professional, and clinic simultaneously.
svg.text: Three tokens. Three trust problems solved simultaneously.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the clinic issue Token 1 to the professional?')
sendPrompt('What does Token 1 allow the professional to do?')
sendPrompt('What does Token 1 solve for each party?')
sendPrompt('How does the professional initiate Token 2?')
sendPrompt('What does Token 2 confirm for the patient?')
sendPrompt('What does the bilateral check-in solve for both sides?')
g.text: Patient: the right person is at the door

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the clinic do when Token 3 closes?')
